source: client brief — HEATPROOF HP-700T hot billet identification (800°C)

title.zh: HEATPROOF HP-700T 钢坯高温识别方案
title.en: HEATPROOF HP-700T — Steel Billet High-Temperature Identification

subtitle.zh: 在 800°C 热轧钢坯上直接贴标，一标到底、全流程精准追溯。
subtitle.en: Applied directly to 800°C hot-rolled billets — one label all the way, precise end-to-end traceability.

seo_desc.zh: 用 HEATPROOF HP-700T 在 800°C 热轧钢坯上直贴标识——以标准条码替代人工喷涂，实现从轧机前工序到库存、出货的一码全程精准追溯。
seo_desc.en: Direct-application labeling for 800°C hot-rolled steel billets with HEATPROOF HP-700T — scannable barcodes replace manual spray-marking for one-code, end-to-end traceability from the rolling line through inventory to shipping.

zh.label: 应用范围
zh.value: 轧机前工序、库存管理及出货环节

en.label: Scope
en.value: Pre-rolling process, inventory management and shipping

intro.zh: 现场目前采用人工分段喷涂方式进行钢坯标识。受 800°C 高温限制，无法实现自动化连续标识，长期存在多项生产问题：
intro.en: The site currently marks billets by manual, section-by-section spray painting. Constrained by the 800°C heat, automated continuous marking is impossible, and several production problems persist:

zh: 喷涂标识会随高温氧化皮脱落，钢坯进入轧机前标识丢失。
钢坯冷却后人工补贴标签，极易出现贴错、物料混淆问题。
喷涂文字无标准编码、无法扫码识别，人工肉眼核对易出错，影响后道工序。
人工分段喷涂工作量大、效率低、出错率高。
en: Sprayed marks flake off with the high-temperature oxide scale, so identification is lost before the billet enters the rolling mill.
Labels re-applied by hand after the billet cools are highly prone to mislabeling and material mix-ups.
Sprayed text has no standard code and cannot be scanned, so manual visual checking is error-prone and disrupts downstream processes.
Manual section-by-section spraying is labor-intensive, inefficient and error-prone.

zh.label: 条码精准识别
zh.text: 替代传统喷涂文字，采用标准条码，实现单块钢坯唯一溯源。

zh.label: 高温前置贴标
zh.text: HP-700T 采用先进热激活胶粘剂技术，综合性能优异。钢坯出炉后由机器臂自动粘贴标签，800°C 高温工况下可稳定贴合，随钢坯降温粘结强度持续递增，牢固度更高。标签兼具超强耐高温、抗氧化、耐候性能，全程稳固不脱落、标识不失效，真正实现一标到底、全流程精准追溯。

zh.label: 支持自动扫码
zh.text: 可适配扫码设备及视觉识别设备，无需人工重复复核物料。

zh.label: 全流程校验
zh.text: 出货前条码扫描核验，替代人工目视检查，杜绝发货错误。

en.label: Precise barcode identification
en.text: Replaces traditional sprayed text with a standard barcode, giving each individual billet a unique, traceable identity.

en.label: High-temperature pre-application
en.text: HP-700T uses advanced heat-activated adhesive technology with excellent all-round performance. A robotic arm applies the label right after the billet leaves the furnace; it bonds stably under 800°C conditions and its bond strength keeps increasing as the billet cools. With strong heat, oxidation and weather resistance, it stays firmly attached and legible throughout — truly one label all the way, with precise end-to-end traceability.

en.label: Automatic scanning
en.text: Compatible with barcode scanners and machine-vision equipment, removing repeated manual re-checking of materials.

en.label: Full-process verification
en.text: A barcode scan verifies each billet before shipping, replacing manual visual inspection and preventing shipping errors.

zh: 彻底解决钢坯错标、混料问题。
实现自动化识别，大幅降低人工失误。
提升出货准确率，简化库存对账工作。
优化现场作业流程，降低品质管理成本。
en: Thoroughly eliminates billet mislabeling and material mix-ups.
Automated identification that sharply reduces human error.
Improves shipping accuracy and simplifies inventory reconciliation.
Optimizes on-site workflow and lowers quality-management cost.
